rationale.consistency: Follows cobra/cmdutil/heredoc/httpmock idioms; but a non-test testing.go imports `testing` into production code and a package-level openFile var is swapped for tests.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers extensions, size limits, dir/irregular/empty, SameFile dedup, empty/'-' values, code fences, ref definitions, video-alone paragraphs; but partial uploads still write the body and edit continues after upload failure, contrary to 'nothing is written'.
rationale.scope: Adds KeepExistingBody knob no caller sets false, hasDeferredEdits refactor, a StopProgressIndicator fix and RepoNetwork databaseId beyond the ask; otherwise on target.
rationale.readability: Clear names, but a 746-line hand-rolled inline link scanner beside goldmark and very verbose, repeated prose comments weigh it down.
rationale.robustness: No panics seen, bodies/files closed; but ContentLength from earlier Stat, partial-success writes and edits proceeding on upload failure weaken the all-or-nothing guarantee.
rationale.maintainability: newUploader is duplicated five times across command packages; custom markdown scanner duplicates goldmark's job and will be hard to keep correct; unexported-method interface limits extension.
